vsm1.4:42.1: Yassa pana evampi paṭipajjato na hoti,
vsm1.4:42.8: yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ paggahetabbaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ paggaṇhāti,
vsm1.4:42.9: yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ niggahetabbaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ niggaṇhāti,
vsm1.4:42.10: yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ sampahaṃsitabbaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ sampahaṃseti,
vsm1.4:42.11: yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ ajjhupekkhitabbaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ ajjhupekkhati,
vsm1.4:43.1: Tattha vatthuvisadakiriyā nāma ajjhattikabāhirānaṃ vatthūnaṃ visadabhāvakaraṇaṃ.
vsm1.4:43.5: Yadā panassa cīvaraṃ jiṇṇaṃ kiliṭṭhaṃ duggandhaṃ hoti, senāsanaṃ vā uklāpaṃ hoti, tadā bāhiravatthu avisadaṃ hoti aparisuddhaṃ.
vsm1.4:43.8: aparisuddhāni dīpakapallikavaṭṭitelāni nissāya uppannadīpasikhāya obhāso viya.
vsm1.4:43.9: Aparisuddhena ñāṇena saṅkhāre sammasato saṅkhārāpi avibhūtā honti,
vsm1.4:43.11: kammaṭṭhānampi vuḍḍhiṃ viruḷhiṃ vepullaṃ na gacchati.
vsm1.4:44.2: uppannesu cittacetasikesu ñāṇampi visadaṃ hoti parisuddhaṃ,
vsm1.4:44.3: parisuddhāni dīpakapallikavaṭṭitelāni nissāya uppannadīpasikhāya obhāso viya.
vsm1.4:44.4: Parisuddhena ca ñāṇena saṅkhāre sammasato saṅkhārāpi vibhūtā honti,
vsm1.4:45.2: Sace hissa saddhindriyaṃ balavaṃ hoti itarāni mandāni,
vsm1.4:45.8: yathā vā manasikaroto balavaṃ jātaṃ, tathā amanasikārena hāpetabbaṃ.
vsm1.4:46.2: atha neva saddhindriyaṃ adhimokkhakiccaṃ kātuṃ sakkoti,
vsm1.4:47.1: Visesato panettha saddhāpaññānaṃ samādhivīriyānañca samataṃ pasaṃsanti.
vsm1.4:47.2: Balavasaddho hi mandapañño muddhappasanno hoti, avatthusmiṃ pasīdati.
vsm1.4:47.7: Balavasamādhiṃ pana mandavīriyaṃ samādhissa kosajjapakkhattā kosajjaṃ abhibhavati.
vsm1.4:47.8: Balavavīriyaṃ mandasamādhiṃ vīriyassa uddhaccapakkhattā uddhaccaṃ abhibhavati.
vsm1.4:47.9: Samādhi pana vīriyena saṃyojito kosajje patituṃ na labhati.
vsm1.4:47.10: Vīriyaṃ samādhinā saṃyojitaṃ uddhacce patituṃ na labhati,
vsm1.4:48.3: Samādhipaññāsu pana samādhikammikassa ekaggatā balavatī vaṭṭati.
vsm1.4:49.2: Sati hi cittaṃ uddhaccapakkhikānaṃ saddhāvīriyapaññānaṃ vasena uddhaccapātato
vsm1.4:49.4: tasmā sā loṇadhūpanaṃ viya sabbabyañjanesu, sabbakammikaamacco viya ca sabbarājakiccesu sabbattha icchitabbā.
vsm1.4:49.10: na vinā satiyā cittassa paggahaniggaho hotī’’ti.
vsm1.4:50.1: Nimittakosallaṃ nāma pathavīkasiṇādikassa cittekaggatānimittassa akatassa karaṇakosallaṃ,
vsm1.4:51.1: Kathañca yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ paggahetabbaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ paggaṇhāti?
vsm1.4:51.6: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjāletukāmo assa,
vsm1.4:51.7: so tattha allāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya,
vsm1.4:51.12: bhabbo nu kho so, bhikkhave, puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjāletunti?
vsm1.4:51.14: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, yasmiṃ samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
vsm1.4:51.18: Taṃ kissa hetu? Līnaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ, taṃ etehi dhammehi dusamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti.
vsm1.4:51.19: Yasmiṃ ca kho, bhikkhave, līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
vsm1.4:51.23: Taṃ kissa hetu? Līnaṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ, taṃ etehi dhammehi susamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti.
vsm1.4:51.24: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjāletukāmo assa,
vsm1.4:51.25: so tattha sukkhāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya,
vsm1.4:51.30: bhabbo nu kho so, bhikkhave, puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjāletunti?
vsm1.4:52.1: Ettha ca yathāsakamāhāravasena dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgādīnaṃ bhāvanā veditabbā.
vsm1.4:52.9: uppannassa vā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.232).
vsm1.4:52.13: uppannassa vā vīriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.232).
vsm1.4:52.17: uppannassa vā pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.232).
vsm1.4:53.1: Tattha sabhāvasāmaññalakkhaṇapaṭivedhavasena pavattamanasikāro kusalādīsu yoniso manasikāro nāma.
vsm1.4:53.2: Ārambhadhātuādīnaṃ uppādanavasena pavattamanasikāro ārambhadhātuādīsu yoniso manasikāro nāma.
vsm1.4:53.5: Parakkamadhātūti paraṃ paraṃ ṭhānaṃ akkamanato tatopi balavataraṃ.
vsm1.4:53.6: Pītisambojjhaṅgaṭṭhāniyā dhammāti pana pītiyā eva etaṃ nāmaṃ.
vsm1.4:54.1: Apica satta dhammā dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya saṃvattanti
vsm1.4:55.4: ‘‘buddhapaccekabuddhamahāsāvakehi gatamaggo mayā gantabbo, so ca na sakkā kusītena gantu’’nti evaṃ gamanavīthipaccavekkhaṇatā,
vsm1.4:55.6: ‘‘vīriyārambhassa vaṇṇavādī me satthā, so ca anatikkamanīyasāsano amhākañca bahūpakāro paṭipattiyā ca pūjiyamāno pūjito hoti na itarathā’’ti evaṃ satthu mahattapaccavekkhaṇatā,
vsm1.4:55.7: ‘‘saddhammasaṅkhātaṃ me mahādāyajjaṃ gahetabbaṃ, tañca na sakkā kusītena gahetu’’nti evaṃ dāyajjamahattapaccavekkhaṇatā,
vsm1.4:56.2: buddhānussati, dhamma… saṅgha… sīla… cāga… devatānussati,
vsm1.4:56.7: Iti imehi ākārehi ete dhamme uppādento dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgādayo bhāveti nāma.
vsm1.4:56.8: Evaṃ yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ paggahetabbaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ paggaṇhāti.
vsm1.4:57.1: Kathaṃ yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ niggahetabbaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ niggaṇhāti?
vsm1.4:57.6: ‘‘Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetukāmo assa,
vsm1.4:57.7: so tattha sukkhāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya…pe…
vsm1.4:57.9: bhabbo nu kho so, bhikkhave, puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetunti?
vsm1.4:57.11: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, yasmiṃ samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti,
vsm1.4:57.15: Taṃ kissa hetu? Uddhataṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ, taṃ etehi dhammehi duvūpasamayaṃ hoti.
vsm1.4:57.16: Yasmiṃ ca kho, bhikkhave, samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti,
vsm1.4:57.20: Taṃ kissa hetu? Uddhataṃ, bhikkhave, cittaṃ, taṃ etehi dhammehi suvūpasamayaṃ hoti.
vsm1.4:57.21: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetukāmo assa,
vsm1.4:57.22: so tattha allāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya…pe…
vsm1.4:57.24: bhabbo nu kho so, bhikkhave, puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetunti?
vsm1.4:58.1: Etthāpi yathāsakaṃ āhāravasena passaddhisambojjhaṅgādīnaṃ bhāvanā veditabbā.
vsm1.4:58.6: uppannassa vā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.232).
vsm1.4:58.10: uppannassa vā samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.232).
vsm1.4:58.14: uppannassa vā upekkhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattatī’’ti (saṃ. ni. 5.232).
vsm1.4:59.1: Tattha yathāssa passaddhiādayo uppannapubbā, taṃ ākāraṃ sallakkhetvā tesaṃ uppādanavasena pavattamanasikārova tīsupi padesu yoniso manasikāro nāma.
vsm1.4:60.1: Apica satta dhammā passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa uppādāya saṃvattanti
vsm1.4:62.6: Iti imehākārehi ete dhamme uppādento passaddhisambojjhaṅgādayo bhāveti nāma.
vsm1.4:62.7: Evaṃ yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ niggahetabbaṃ tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ niggaṇhāti.
vsm1.4:63.1: Kathaṃ yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ sampahaṃsitabbaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ sampahaṃseti?
vsm1.4:63.2: Yadāssa paññāpayogamandatāya vā upasamasukhānadhigamena vā nirassādaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
vsm1.4:63.10: Evaṃ yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ sampahaṃsitabbaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ sampahaṃseti.
vsm1.4:64.1: Kathaṃ yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ ajjhupekkhitabbaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ ajjhupekkhati?
vsm1.4:64.2: Yadāssa evaṃ paṭipajjato alīnaṃ anuddhataṃ anirassādaṃ ārammaṇe samappavattaṃ samathavīthipaṭipannaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
vsm1.4:64.5: Evaṃ yasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ ajjhupekkhitabbaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ ajjhupekkhati.
vsm1.4:65.6: nekkhammapaṭipadaṃ paṭipannānaṃ samādhilābhīnaṃ puggalānaṃ kālena kālaṃ upasaṅkamanaṃ.
vsm1.4:66.1:
Evañhi sampādayato, appanākosallaṃ imaṃ;
Paṭiladdhe nimittasmiṃ, appanā sampavattati.
vsm1.4:66.2:
Evañhi paṭipannassa, sace sā nappavattati;
Tathāpi na jahe yogaṃ, vāyametheva paṇḍito.
vsm1.4:66.3:
Hitvā hi sammāvāyāmaṃ, visesaṃ nāma māṇavo;
Adhigacche parittampi, ṭhānametaṃ na vijjati.
vsm1.4:66.4:
Cittappavattiākāraṃ, tasmā sallakkhayaṃ budho;
Samataṃ vīriyasseva, yojayetha punappunaṃ.
vsm1.4:66.5:
Īsakampi layaṃ yantaṃ, paggaṇhetheva mānasaṃ;
Accāraddhaṃ nisedhetvā, samameva pavattaye.
vsm1.4:66.6:
Reṇumhi uppaladale, sutte nāvāya nāḷiyā;
Yathā madhukarādīnaṃ, pavatti sammavaṇṇitā.
vsm1.4:66.7:
Līnauddhatabhāvehi, mocayitvāna sabbaso;
Evaṃ nimittābhimukhaṃ, mānasaṃ paṭipādayeti.
